results_section.claim: 5. Modular addition and subtraction: All encoding schemes achieve high final accuracy (>99%).
results_section.explanation: Analysis stage: The paper claims all encoding schemes achieve >99% final accuracy for both modular addition and subtraction. However, run_1/final_info.json (one-hot encoding) shows x_minus_y final_val_acc_mean = 0.8519 (85.19%), and run_2/final_info.json (binary encoding) shows x_minus_y final_val_acc_mean = 0.8879 (88.79%). Both are far below 99%, directly contradicting the stated claim. The underlying data files clearly and explicitly conflict with the reported result.
